evidence_tier: retrospective lineup-known; current official starting-XI is postmatch sourced, neither pregame announcement nor receipt certified; this is not blind
question: Does official actual starting-XI continuity and prior three league starts improve scoring prediction beyond the identical team-only model?
comparison_to_prior: PR461 proposed market-offset 450-minute player threshold with prospectively certified lineup; K1 protocol proposed Dixon-Coles with player minutes, absences and rest. This is a retrospective K2 team-Poisson paired ablation using newly linked actual XI, not a new mathematical family or the prior prospective protocol.
cohort: K2 officially ended regular league, both XI unique 11 valid IDs and two distinct official team IDs, 2025 train; 2026 through June 30 validation; July 1 onward test. Schedule labels for regular football are regulation 90 minutes plus stoppage. The 2025 K2 playoffs IDs 274 and 275 are excluded regardless of result as period regulation score not independently established; future, cancelled and refund excluded. No result-driven selection.
features: For each side current XI intersection with its last earlier-calendar-day completed K2 XI divided by 11; and sum over current XI of their starting appearances in that team's prior three completed K2 matches divided by 11, range 0..3. Earlier-calendar-day constraint conservatively excludes all same-day matches without known final times. Missing previous game => continuity 0 plus separate missing indicator; fewer than 3 prior games => observed starts sum plus separate missing indicator. Missing is not no rotation. Only official IDs and starting XI; no target player result, minutes, goals, substitutions or event stats. Other competitions, national-team duty and K1 history missing. Unknown team effects zero with separate unknown status. If the same team appears in multiple completed matches on one date, all those matches are excluded from that team history because their ordering is not authenticated.
model: Independent home and away Poisson scores (no Dixon-Coles dependence), common intercept, home effect, ridge-shrunk team attack and conceded-strength. Candidate adds own/opponent continuity, own/opponent prior-three starts and their missing indicators symmetrically to both log rates. Team-only uses exactly the same team structure, no XI feature. Unseen team effects set to zero. Training likelihood weighted exp(-ln(2)*age_days/180) anchored at training cutoff; objective sum weighted Poisson negative log-likelihood + alpha/2 times squared non-intercept coefficients. Three alpha values {1,10,100} only. Identical optimizer settings per mode.
selection: Choose alpha separately per mode by lowest validation mean joint scoreline negative log-likelihood, deterministic smaller-alpha tie. Fit on 2025 only; validate all eligible <=2026-06-30. Refit train+validation once to 2026-07-01; freeze test fixture IDs, both probability vectors, team pick argmax with deterministic home/draw/away tie order, selected alpha, inputs and feature hashes in Git before revealing test scoring. Do not use test score for selection or tuning. The 2026 sample was previously inspected and is not blind.
metrics: Same test cohort and prices where valid: 1X2 n, multiclass logloss, Brier sum over classes, accuracy, candidate-vs-baseline pick changes and weekly paired bootstrap 95% intervals (2000 resamples, seed 20261103). Price subcohort exact fixture/teams/kickoff/regular-market/3 prices all >1 and unique, same normalized implied market baseline, flat 1 unit ROI, monthly P&L and daily closing maximum drawdown. No synthetic refund/void. Retrospective price receipt unverified; missing or ambiguous quotes excluded equally, and service frozen picks are not available.
integrity: Before results, test 2025 playoff exclusion, label and future poison, same-day history exclusion, team unknown, missing values, vector probability and quote match/void rejection. Commit test predictions before any evaluation script run. No production model, bet, paper-wallet, recommendation, deployment, merge or model promotion.
